The Problem

You already know wholesaling works. You just don't have a system — or a deadline.

You've watched the videos, saved the PDFs, and told yourself "this month I'll actually do it." Then the leads pile up, the numbers never get verified, and the contract sits unsigned. Rachel's challenge replaces intention with a plan you do one action a day — the same actions that put assignment fees in real mailboxes.

The Solution

Estimate ARV from recent comps, build a conservative repair list, and stress-test every assumption before you commit a dime.

About Rachel

Your coach is a deal-doer, not a course-seller

Rachel coaches real-estate assignment-of-contract — getting a property under an assignable contract and assigning it to an end buyer for a fee, never owning it. The method only works when it's done ethically, transparently, and with real numbers. That's the standard she holds every day of the challenge.

Her coaching style is direct: verify the comp, confirm the motivation, check the contract with qualified counsel, and disclose everything to the buyer. No scripted hype. No fabricated comps. Just a repeatable path to your first assignment fee.

FAQ

Questions, answered straight

Is assigning contracts legal in my state?

Assignment of contract is legal in most states, but rules differ. Always confirm with a qualified local real-estate attorney or title/escrow professional before marketing, signing, or assigning. The challenge is educational, not legal advice.

Do I need a real-estate license?

Generally no — assigning a contract positions you as a private party, not a licensed broker, in most jurisdictions. But state rules vary, and some compensation structures require a license. Verify locally with qualified counsel.

Do I need money to start?

A small marketing budget helps, but the challenge centers on free and low-cost sources: driving for dollars, motivated-seller outreach, your network, and permission-based conversations.

What if I don't hit $3,500 in 30 days?

$3,500 is a target, not a promise — your results depend on your market, activity, and follow-through. You keep every playbook and script forever, and Pro/Platinum members keep coaching until that first fee lands.

How much time does it take daily?

45–90 minutes a day for missions, outreach, and deal work. The roadmap is built for evenings and weekends, so you can run it alongside a job.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Memberships are monthly, and you can cancel anytime from your Stripe billing portal. No long-term contracts.
